name_or_rule: Install->paid under 3% (7-day rolling, at 200+ installs): stop growth spend and new outreach waves; fix paywall + first scan first.
Install->trial under 5% at Day 7: fix paywall/first scan before any boost.
Successful portraits / scans started under 80%: fix scan guidance before anything else.
Winning reel = 3x median reel views OR profile taps >= 2% of views: post 2 remixes within 3 days, pin it, make it the boost candidate.
A format whose 2 tries both get under half the median views is retired.
Boost in $50 steps. Keep if cost per trial start < $8. Stop if > $15 after $150 on that boost. Warn at $250 total. Hard stop at $300 total.
Creator code with 0 redemptions after 7 days: send that creator nothing more. Top-redeeming creator: ask for a second video.
Paid creator fee only if install->paid >= 3% at Day 14; max $150 total; Lusine decides and pays.
After Day 14, if no reel beat 2x median views: switch to 3 reels a week and put time into paywall/first-scan fixes.
Stop all paid activity at $300 total spend or Day 30, whichever comes first.
Formulas: install_to_trial_pct = trial_starts / (installs_ios+installs_android) * 100; install_to_paid_pct = new_paid / installs * 100 (use 7-day rolling sums).
